name: Frontera Funds SKaaS — FIC Funds Intelligence
description: Portable, configurable institutional HTML factsheet and comparative reporting standard for Colombian FICs, with host-independent execution profiles and authorized data capabilities.
author: Jairo Alonso González

service_profile.service_outcome: Produce evidence-led, standardized Spanish-language HTML factsheets or comparative reports for Colombian collective investment funds, with configurable branding, structured findings and source provenance.

separate_library_when: substantial reusable data-processing or analytics functionality is needed
functionality requires independent release and maintenance

integration_requirements.access_policy: The host verifies source access, licensing, entitlements and permissions for each invocation. The Skill declares data capabilities; the host maps available integrations to those requirements. No specific MCP, connector, API vendor or private SaaS implementation is bundled or required.

output_contract.consistency_policy: Factsheet and comparative report structures, metric definitions, cutoff, provenance, theme metadata and quality gates remain stable across compatible hosts. Branding may be overridden with authorized assets; narrative analysis may differ but must follow evidence and uncertainty rules.

model_portability.target: Compatible Agent Skills hosts and models
model_portability.guarantee: Capability-based execution profiles are specified in compatibility/execution-profiles.yaml and requirements in compatibility/capability-requirements.yaml. Stable report structures, metric definitions, provenance and validation contract; not identical model reasoning or prose.

commercialization.separation_policy: The Skill, data access and managed service are independently packageable and commercial components. The portable Skill does not include hosted data access, execution infrastructure, support, pricing or SLA unless separately contracted.
commercialization.pricing_and_terms: Defined separately by the product owner; not specified in this manifest.

runtime_requirements.python: optional for the lightweight HTML artifact validator; not required to read the methodology or reason over supplied data
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external source retrieval
runtime_requirements.file_generation: requires writable host artifact capability or a user-supplied HTML artifact
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized public data, MCP, API, browser, user-supplied file or licensed provider

branding.asset_policy: Use only authorized brand assets. The bundled Frontera reference mark is user-supplied and excluded from the MIT code license.
branding.implementation_boundary: No dependency on private Frontera SaaS code, services, APIs, infrastructure or runtime.

data_dependencies.name: SFC FIC open-data dataset qhpu-8ixx
data_dependencies.freshness: Capture latest cutoff and retrieval time on every live-data invocation

data_dependencies.name: FIC categorization snapshot
data_dependencies.freshness: Use snapshot's own cutoff and version; never assume latest is current without verification

evaluation.environment: Python 3.13; package-local test environment with PyYAML and jsonschema available
evaluation.report_ref: Package-local regression suite: 17 tests passed; 13 subtests passed; YAML contracts parsed; factsheet and comparative examples validated against Draft 2020-12 output schema.
limitations: Domain analysis quality and investment suitability are not certified.
Standard 1.0.0 and configurable themes require regression validation.
Cross-model execution profiles are specified but not empirically benchmarked.
evaluation.scope: 17 package-local tests and 13 subtests passed. Standard/profile/theme YAML parsed successfully; output examples validate against the updated Draft 2020-12 schema. Factory-wide CI, live MCP integration regression, browser visual QA and cross-model execution remain pending.

runtime_compatibility.surface: Native Skill discovery and optional tool integration
Standard-library HTML artifact validator and package tests
runtime_compatibility.evidence_ref: 17 package-local tests passed; 13 subtests passed; both report templates structurally validated.
